patterns.title: Native button Space/Enter activation
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab focus; Enter and Space activate once; disabled not focusable in normal tab order
invariants: Button type=button unless submit explicitly chosen; no nested interactive elements
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Native navigation hyperlink
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab, Enter follows href; no Space-as-button
invariants: No href => no link semantics; no fake disabled link without explicit policy
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Native editable input
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab; typing/editing/selection native; Enter submit only by form behavior
invariants: Preserve name/value/required/readOnly, label and error relationships
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Native file control
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab to input or labeled trigger; Enter/Space opens picker
invariants: Do not simulate upload; app owns files, size/type validation
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Native checkbox
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab to box; Space toggles once
invariants: checked/defaultChecked and onCheckedChange proposal; preserve name/indeterminate separately
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Radio group APG / native radios
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab into group; arrow movement between enabled radios; Space selects
invariants: Group name, required state and native form participation
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Accessible switch
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab and Space toggle; Enter provider-specific must be tested
invariants: Checked state and label; not color-only
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Native single selection baseline
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab; browser/platform keyboard selection
invariants: Prefer native select where appropriate; custom popup requires separate pattern
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Select-only popup
patterns.keyboardContract: Open from trigger; arrows/typeahead; Enter select; Escape close/restore
invariants: Custom popup semantics/form serialization must be proven before API approval
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Editable combobox/listbox
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab focus input; ArrowDown/Up navigate; Enter commits; Escape dismisses; typeahead native
invariants: Keyboard model varies with popup kind; async results don't steal focus
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Multi-selection widget
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab enter; arrows navigate; Space toggle; selection remains explicit
invariants: Exact keyboard model and form serialization pending provider fixture
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Menu button / menu items
patterns.keyboardContract: Enter/Space open; arrows/Home/End/typeahead items; Escape closes and returns focus
invariants: Action menu not ordinary navigation; submenus must match APG
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Menubar
patterns.keyboardContract: ArrowLeft/Right top-level; ArrowUp/Down submenu; Escape collapses; typeahead
invariants: RTL reversals must be tested; no arbitrary navigation bar role
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Tabs manual activation proposal
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab to selected tab; arrows/Home/End move focus; Enter/Space activate manual tab
invariants: Auto activation only if no latency and explicitly chosen
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Modal dialog
patterns.keyboardContract: Trigger Enter/Space; Tab/Shift+Tab within modal; Escape dismisses unless justified
invariants: Initial focus and restoration, inert backdrop, labeled title; nested overlays
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: AlertDialog confirmation
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab through actions, Escape policy explicitly documented, focus safe action first when destructive
invariants: No implicit confirmation on mount; async confirmation completion app-owned
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Non-modal interactive popover
patterns.keyboardContract: Trigger Enter/Space; Tab normal interaction within; Escape closes and restores focus as appropriate
invariants: Not a tooltip; modality and outside interaction specified by component
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Informational tooltip
patterns.keyboardContract: Focus/hover trigger opens; Escape dismisses; focus stays trigger
invariants: No interactive controls in tooltip; APG pattern still work in progress
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Accordion/collapsible disclosure
patterns.keyboardContract: Enter/Space toggle, Tab through headers; arrows only in approved accordion pattern
invariants: Associate controlled region, orientation and disabled behavior
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Toggle button
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab; Enter/Space toggle once; announce pressed state
invariants: Don't treat pressed state as checkbox unless semantics fit
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Group of toggles
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab to group, arrows optional per toolbar model; Enter/Space toggles
invariants: Selection single/multiple discriminated union required
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Slider
patterns.keyboardContract: Arrow keys +/- step; Home/End min/max; PageUp/Down optional consistent
invariants: Accessible min/max/now/text; RTL horizontal behavior validate
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Calendar date/grid selection
patterns.keyboardContract: Arrows move date focus; Home/End week; PageUp/Down months per selected pattern
invariants: Locale, timezone, disabled dates; don't invent date engine
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Tree view
patterns.keyboardContract: Arrows navigate; Right expand/Left collapse; Home/End; typeahead
invariants: Separate focus/selection/expansion, keyboard screen reader review
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Native semantic data table
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab only interactive cells; no roving tabindex in plain table
invariants: th/scope/caption/row headings; no grid role unless true interactive grid
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Controlled sortable/paged table
patterns.keyboardContract: Sort header is button; Tab navigates controls; row selection via checkbox
invariants: Headless engine optional; advanced grid keys not promised
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Navigation/landmark
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab through links/buttons, native activation; Escape only overlay variant
invariants: No menubar arrow model for basic nav; adapt reading/focus order on mobile
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Page navigation
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab and Enter/Space per element, announce current page
invariants: Cursor backend may not know total; never fabricate page totals
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Search-and-command dialog
patterns.keyboardContract: Open by trigger/approved shortcut; arrows navigate; Enter executes intent; Escape dismisses
invariants: Never capture platform shortcuts globally without opt-in
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: One-time code fields
patterns.keyboardContract: Native typing/paste/delete; deterministic focus advance, backspace and arrow behavior
invariants: Never log OTP/password; full form handling by consumer
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Resizable separator
patterns.keyboardContract: Keyboard arrows resize; Home/End reach bounds; pointer drag parity
invariants: Persisting pane sizes is app-owned; reduced motion
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Announced non-modal notification
patterns.keyboardContract: No focus theft, Tab to dismissal/action if present, Escape not universal
invariants: Live region urgency, pause timeout, readable duration; no duplicate announcements
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Copy-action button
patterns.keyboardContract: Tab, Enter/Space once; announce copy outcome after app/browser confirmation
invariants: Clipboard permission failure must be reported, not invented success
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Noninteractive semantic presentation
patterns.keyboardContract: No added keyboard stops unless child is interactive
invariants: No focus/hover/disabled APIs unless meaningful per child
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: State-driven presentation/status
patterns.keyboardContract: Only contained real controls tabbable; retry is button/link
invariants: No hidden fetch/network, success state controlled externally
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Progress indication
patterns.keyboardContract: Not focusable by default; announce status and value where relevant
invariants: Indeterminate and determinate are separate states; no motion-only progress
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes

patterns.title: Form labels/field associations
patterns.keyboardContract: Native control focus; no extra custom shortcuts
invariants: Field owns associations, input owns value/DOM; FormMessage owns message contents
Cross-skin behavior/focus/aria is invariant; 15 skins × 2 effective modes
